rules: Synchronous foreground only; no IRQ/NMI borrower or nested callback
Ownership ends after the last copy/compare/CRC in the caller; no bytes survive a handoff
Trace caller data must not alias scratch; record/header remain independent
ROM block remains separate because source and readback are simultaneously live
Every borrower initializes or reads all bytes it consumes; failure exits abandon contents
Existing physical-range checks, copy failures, capacities and checksums are unchanged
